index.projectDescription:
Deep Research is an AI research agent: give it a question and it plans web searches, digs deeper across multiple rounds, verifies findings against real source pages, and writes a cited report.
Responses stream in for realtime feedback, and the research process is visualized as a tree.
In Client Mode, all API requests are sent directly from your browser and no data is stored remotely.
index.missingConfigDescription: This project requires you to bring your own API keys.
